information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDFall2024#43160-competitor-responsibilities) tab. # This competition is primarily an Unofficial Events competition. You can register for unofficial events [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDUnofficialEvents2025#59768-must-read-unofficial-events-info-registration) Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. **UCSD students can get their registration fee waived!** More details in the **"UCSD Student Registration Fee Waiver"** tab. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) A portion of the profits from this competition will be donated to the Rubik's Cube Club @ UC San Diego, a registered UC San Diego Student Organization.
